text:
Marta: PSA: Bento the bearded dragon tried to join my standup and now insists the whiteboard is his basking rock. pic: https://img.internal/bento-whiteboard-bask.jpg :lizard: :white_small_square: 
Leo: majestic. also those tiny beard pebbles are a whole vibe. :heart_eyes: 
Ivy: does he accept meeting minutes as snacks? 
Marta: he prefers roasted sweet potato but will settle for sticky-note endorsements. 
Kai: request: does Bento approve the new ergonomic chair? He looks like a chair critic. 
Marta: he did a three-second stare and then a slow tail wag. unanimous approval. 
ops-bot: Reminder: please keep meeting rooms clear of hot lamps and secure any space heaters when pets are present. :warning: 
Leo: GIF request: slow tongue-flick of approval pls. 
Marta: GIF: https://img.internal/bento-tongue.gif 
Ivy: adding Bento to my "calm down before sprint" playlist. 
Kai: vote: should Bento get an official title: "Chief Warmth Officer"? 
Marta: yes. also a tiny nameplate. 
Leo: yes. also small sweater? debatable. 
Ivy: No sweater. heat conservation only. 
ops-bot: Poll created: "Bento named Chief Warmth Officer?" Options: Yes / No / Only virtual coronation. 
Marta: voted Yes. 
Leo: voted Only virtual coronation (sweaters are frightening). 
Ivy: voted Yes. 
Marta: last update: Bento relocated to the sunny sill and sent a dignified blink. requests more roasted sweet potato for future ceremonial duties. 
Kai: reaction: :tada:
